purpose: Improve learned tradable price-move and TP-before-SL forecasts; paper spot only
common_origin_gate: 512 completed contiguous M15 bars inside each split, six-hour UTC origins, entire 24-hour future inside same split
supervised_input: Last128 completed M15 bars;31 causal summary features or128x9 sequence
chronos_geometries: Existing model_geometry g0/g1/g2 over native marginal close quantiles; do not fabricate joint paths
entry_requirement: Learned expected net payoff strictly positive, target clears costs, executable geometry, shared cash and risk limits
selection_rule: Validation only: at least5 closed trades, positive net PnL at0bp and15bp scenario, maximize return_pct minus0.5 marked_drawdown_pct; stable declared iteration order for ties. If none qualify, label exploratory.
test_use: Freeze global validation-selected model and policy before opening TEST outcomes. Report selected policy and per-family validation-selected comparators, never replace selected policy with TEST winner.
prohibitions: No old July-October fine-tuned weights on earlier July TEST
No current news or fundamental backfill into historical evaluation
timesfm_status: Separate pretrained acquisition and execution probe only; not eligible for this frozen policy comparison without a new validation protocol
